author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m waterproofing a large shower wall using 4 foot by 8 foot KERDI-BOARD panels. This speeds up the installation and also helps keep the wall flat, which is incredibly helpful when setting tiles. I also use extra KERDI-BOARD material to build custom niches and shower curbs. No doubt, knowing your shower material options is always a good thing, especially when building custom showers
title: Schluter KERDI-BOARD Shower Wall Tips - #showerremodel #schlutersystems #sponsored
